title: Wizard form final-submit gate judges visibleWhen without the form's formula recompute
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

## What

#35116 made the form compute the object's `formula` fields over the record being edited before it judges field rules. That is `planObjectFormulas` (`ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/formulaRecord.ts`), applied in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` (`ruleRecord = formulaPlan.compute(...)`) and `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`.

One form-side judge was not changed. `gateFinalSubmit` in `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx` (about line 865) calls `resolveFieldRuleState` over `mergedData`, the last-read record, with no formula plan. Per the file's own comment (about line 729), a simple form's mobile stepper also submits through it.

So on a wizard, or on the mobile stepper, a `required` field whose `visibleWhen` reads a formula is judged on the stale formula value. After an edit that moves the field out of (or into) the condition, the final-submit gate can demand a field the server does not require, or skip one it does.

A smaller residual in the same family: in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/objectFormulas.ts`, a data source without `getObjectSchema`, or a failed schema read, yields no plan. The form then judges on the stored value.

## Cheapest disproof

Write one `WizardForm` test. Give it a required field whose `visibleWhen` reads a formula, make an edit that moves the formula value out of the condition, then final-submit. Today the gate judges the pre-edit value.

## Origin

Contract review 6977080790 on PR #34978 (S7, read, not run). PR #34978 records the residual in ADR-0113. The fix belongs to #35116's surface (card #35033's area), not #34978's.

Re-check: `git grep -n "resolveFieldRuleState\|planObjectFormulas" origin/main -- ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx`
